GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091-J (27 Mar 46) GS
(SCAPIN-846)
APO 500
27 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Suspension of Possible Undesirable Personnel from Public Office.
1. The Japanese press has recently reported the appointment of thirty (30) new members to the House of Peers. Investigation by this Headquarters revealed that the Imperial Japanese Government did not obtain the required questionnaire as outlined in SCAPIN 550, 4 January 1946, subject: “Removal and Exclusion of Undesirable Personnel from Public Office”, nor did they officially determine and certify that such appointees were not barred from public office by the terms of the above directive or the official Imperial Japanese Government’s interpretation thereof.
2. Furthermore, this departure from the required procedure is aggravated by the fact that representatives of Counter Intelligence Section had previously and on several occasions instructed the proper officials of the Japanese Government to obtain the required questionnaire and to determine that any proposed appointee was not barred from public office prior to effecting his appointment and releasing public notification thereof.
3. The appointees referred to will exercise no prerogatives pending compliance by the Japanese Government with the above procedure. Specifically, the Japanese government will secure from each such individual the required questionnaire, will determine whether the individual is barred from government service and will submit their action for final review by the Supreme Commander.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B.M.FICHI
Brigadiar General,AGD,
Adjutant General
